summary: Regression + new-feature test of VAANI 'Competition Edition'. FOUND AND FIXED A SHIP-BLOCKING CRASH: /app/chat rendered only the error boundary ('Something interrupted VAANI') because Chat.jsx declared startDemo (useCallback deps [demo.running, send, setLang]) ABOVE `const send = useCallback(...)`, causing a TDZ 'ReferenceError: Cannot access send before initialization' on every render. I moved startDemo below send (declaration order only, no functional change) and then tested everything. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_competition.py (13 tests) for POST /api/translate (en->hi, hi->en, default target, empty/missing validation), grounded-flag persistence + confidence band, TTS, document upload->ask->DELETE lifecycle, knowledge/status regression. Full suite now 34/34 PASSED. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080 + 390x844): chat streaming + confidence badge (96-100%, green, 'Verified from documents', grounded now survives reload), 5 citation cards, quick-action chips (EN + HI) sending a second grounded answer, translate button (works, ~15-20s), word-highlight TTS play/stop toggle, mic listening panel + waveform start/stop, Demo Mode banner/autopilot/stop, Am-I-Eligible wizard end-to-end (3 steps -> auto-sent eligibility question -> 100% grounded answer with 5 citations), document upload -> ask -> read-aloud -> citation cards in modal -> delete, Settings wake-word/SFX/auto-voice toggles with localStorage persistence across reload, offline banner appear/disappear + service-worker registration, Knowledge browse/filter/semantic search, History list/search/bookmarks, System Status, Hindi UI + Hindi grounded answer. Previous iteration_1 HIGH bugs (grounded flag lost, mobile composer under the dock, Enter-only history search, missing doc delete, doc-ask citations, confidence calibration) are all verified fixed. All QA data cleaned up (17 QA conversations + all uploaded docs deleted; also removed 2 leftover TEST_water_tax docs left behind by earlier manual testing; KB back to 12 docs / 24 vectors).

minor.issue: Latency is 15-20s for a ~1.5KB answer (full LLM round trip, no streaming). Acceptable functionally but the frontend gives no progress feedback (see UI bug). Consider streaming or a faster/cheaper model for translation.

ui_bugs.issue: SHIP-BLOCKER (fixed by me): startDemo's useCallback dependency array referenced `send` before `const send = useCallback` was initialized -> TDZ ReferenceError on every render, so the whole /app/chat route rendered only the error boundary. Nothing in Chat (streaming, quick actions, translate, TTS, demo, mic) was reachable. Fix applied: startDemo moved below send. Main agent must review/keep this ordering.

No loading/pending state. POST /api/translate takes 15-20s and the button shows no spinner, is not disabled, and no skeleton appears; the app looks broken and the user can fire duplicate requests (a second click while in-flight is interpreted as the toggle-off path).

Still open from iteration_1: textarea rows=1 with the long placeholder wraps to 2 lines and the second line is visually clipped ('Ask about schemes, insurance, farming...'). Overlap with the mobile dock IS fixed (elementFromPoint at send/voice button centres now returns the buttons).

Chips come from a static domain->questions map and are not de-duplicated against what was just asked, so after clicking 'What premium will I pay?' the identical chip is offered again as quick-action-0 on the new answer.
onClick handler `await deleteDocument(d.id)` has no try/catch: a failing delete produces an unhandled promise rejection, a false 'Deleted' toast is skipped and the user gets no error feedback.

Testability: while recording the button carries an infinite `animate-breathe` transform animation on the button element itself, so Playwright normal clicks fail with 'element is not stable' (force=True needed). Real users are unaffected, but automated tests of stop-recording will keep flaking. Move the animation to a child/pseudo-element or use opacity/box-shadow instead of transform.

issues: Colour still derives from confidence while the label derives from grounded: a fully cited PMFBY follow-up rendered amber 'Confidence 52%' next to 'Verified from documents'. Grounded EN/HI PM-KISAN answers score 96-100% so the High band is now reachable, but follow-up questions can still land in the amber band while labelled verified.
Placeholder text clipped in the composer (see ui_bugs).

critical_code_review_comments: Chat.jsx: a useCallback dependency array that references a `const` declared later in the same component body is a hard TDZ crash, not a lint warning (ESLint react-hooks did not flag it). Any future hook added above `send` must not reference it.
useSpeech.play() sets playingId/activeWord before awaiting speak(); if TTS fails the catch calls stop(), which is correct, but there is no user-visible error toast for a failed TTS request.
Documents.jsx delete handler lacks error handling (unhandled rejection).
demo.js runDemo calls send() without awaiting and relies on a 300ms polling waitIdle over streamingRef; it worked in all runs, but a fast-failing stream could race and skip a step.
Backend translate endpoint imports get_llm inside the function body; move it to module scope for consistency with the rest of server.py.
Still open from iteration_1 (low): blocking ChromaDB embedding/query calls run inline in async handlers (rag.retrieve / store.query / ingest.semantic_preview) — wrap in asyncio.to_thread.

New file test_competition.py covers /api/translate, grounded persistence (asserts confidence >= 0.75 for the EN PM-KISAN query), TTS, and the full document upload->ask->delete lifecycle; it cleans up after itself. Frontend gotchas discovered: (1) navigate straight to /app* to skip the cinematic intro; (2) the recording voice-button needs click(force=True) because of animate-breathe; (3) translate takes up to 20s — poll for Devanagari for ~30s; (4) correct testids are knowledge-search-input / knowledge-search-btn / knowledge-doc / knowledge-result / domain-chip, conversation-item / search-result / bookmark-item / history-search-btn, language-switcher / lang-option-hi; (5) documents accumulate in ChromaDB, so always DELETE /api/documents/{id} after uploads. Remaining unfixed items are all cosmetic/low (translate spinner, mobile placeholder clipping, chip dedupe, badge colour unification).
rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE OF THE CRASH: In Chat.jsx the `startDemo` useCallback was inserted at line ~80, above `const send = useCallback(...)` at line ~97, and its dependency array `[demo.running, send, setLang]` is evaluated during render. Reading the `const send` binding before its initializer runs throws a TDZ ReferenceError ('Cannot access send before initialization'), which the VAANI error boundary caught, so /app/chat only ever rendered 'Something interrupted VAANI'. ESLint's react-hooks rules did not detect it and the dev server compiled cleanly, so it was invisible without loading the page. Reproduced deterministically on first load; resolved by moving the startDemo declaration below send, after which every Competition Edition feature (quick actions, translate, TTS highlight, waveform, demo mode) worked.
